Mornings majorly suck when you have POTS.  For as long as I can remember, my heart had pounded ridiculously hard & quick in the mornings as well as a range of other symptoms & throughout the day. I was told told for years that its my anxiety… until this year.. when I received a diagnosis of Postural Tachycardia Syndrome.  Simply standing up can be a challenge for affected people as their body is unable to adjust to gravity. PoTS is due to an abnormal response by the autonomic (automatic) nervous system and is characterised by orthostatic intolerance (the development of symptoms when upright that are mostly relieved by lying down). Symptoms include palpitations, lightheadedness, fatigue, sweating, nausea, fainting and headaches, and are associated with a persistent increase in heart rate from the lying to upright position. Having the Visible band & app personally, really helps me regulate what I am doing. I was hoping that being in a wheelchair would help calm it… it hasn’t 😂😂 #pots #potssyndrome #potsawareness #chronicillness #chronicpain #chronicillnesswarrior #heds #wheelchairlife #wheelchairuser #wheelchairusersoftiktok #disabledtiktok #nervedamage #muscledamage #disabled #disability #neuropathy #posturalorthostatictachycardiasyndrome

Today is my 42nd birthday. Another ‘first’ without my baby boy and a new chapter I will experience without his physical presence. In this new chapter, I intend to fight for justice for my boy and set up his charity as part of his legacy. LONG TERM SIDE EFFECTS OF PREGABALIN FOR NERVE PAIN **Pregabalin: Important Information and Uses** **Warnings:** 1. **Hypersensitivity (Allergic) Reaction**:  This drug can lead to severe allergic reactions, such as breathing difficulties, rashes, and hives. If you experience any of these symptoms, stop taking it and seek immediate medical help. 2. **Suicidal Thoughts and Behavior**:  Pregabalin may increase the risk of suicidal thoughts and actions. Contact your doctor if you notice unusual mood changes, worsening depression, or thoughts of self-harm. 3. **Dizziness and Drowsiness**:  Pregabalin can cause dizziness, drowsiness, and blurred vision, impairing your ability to think and move. Avoid driving or operating machinery until you know how it affects you. 4. **Misuse**:  Be cautious of misuse, especially if you have a history of drug misuse. Only take pregabalin as prescribed by your doctor. 5. **Respiratory Depression**:  If you use pregabalin along with central nervous system depressants like opioids, it can lead to severe breathing problems. Seek immediate medical help if you experience increased sleepiness or breathing difficulties. **What is Pregabalin?** - Pregabalin is a prescription drug available in capsule, solution, and extended-release tablet forms. This discussion focuses on the capsule form. - It is available as a generic drug and under the brand name Lyrica. - Pregabalin may be used alongside other medications, and its use is closely monitored due to its controlled substance status. **Why it's Used:** - Approved to treat neuropathic pain caused by damaged nerves (from diabetes, shingles, or spinal cord injury) in adults. - Effective for fibromyalgia (widespread body pain) in adults. - Used in combination with other seizure medications to manage partial onset seizures in individuals aged 17 and older. - In certain cases, doctors may prescribe it off-label for children under 17, which means for a purpose not officially approved. **How it Works:** - Pregabalin belongs to a class of drugs called anticonvulsants. - Its precise mechanism of action is unclear but is thought to involve calming damaged or overactive nerves that trigger pain or seizures. In summary, pregabalin is a prescription medication used to manage various conditions, but it carries important warnings regarding allergic reactions, potential for suicidal thoughts, dizziness, misuse, and respiratory issues when combined with certain medications. Mikrodozowanie psylocybiny 🍄czyli przyjmowanie niewielkich dawek substancji psychoaktywnej pochodzącej z grzybów halucynogennych, jest tematem badań w kontekście różnych dolegliwości neurologicznych i psychicznych. Chociaż zainteresowanie mikrodozowaniem stale rośnie, aktualne badania naukowe wciąż są ograniczone, szczególnie jeśli chodzi o jego wpływ na leczenie neuropatii. 🍄**Co wiadomo o mikrodozowaniu psylocybiny i jego wpływie na neuropatię?** 1️⃣ **Działanie przeciwbólowe i neuroprotekcyjne**: Psylocybina może wpływać na receptory serotoninowe w mózgu, co z kolei ma potencjalne działanie przeciwbólowe i neuroprotekcyjne. Z tego powodu niektórzy badacze uważają, że może wspomagać radzenie sobie z bólem neuropatycznym. 2️⃣**Regulacja stanu zapalnego**: Psylocybina wykazuje działanie przeciwzapalne, co może być korzystne przy neuropatiach, gdzie zapalenie odgrywa istotną rolę w uszkodzeniu nerwów. 3️⃣**Poprawa nastroju i jakości życia**: Osoby z neuropatią często doświadczają obniżonego nastroju z powodu przewlekłego bólu. Psylocybina, nawet w mikrodozach, może mieć pozytywny wpływ na nastrój, co pośrednio pomaga w lepszym radzeniu sobie z objawami. **⚠️Ograniczenia i ryzyko⚠️**: - **Brak wystarczających dowodów naukowych**: Choć istnieją badania nad mikrodozowaniem psylocybiny i jej wpływem na depresję czy lęk, jest niewiele badań bezpośrednio dotyczących leczenia neuropatii. - **‼️Efekty uboczne**: Nawet mikrodozowanie może wiązać się z ryzykiem skutków ubocznych, takich jak niepokój, zmiany nastroju czy problemy z koncentracją. - **❌Legalność**: Psylocybina jest substancją kontrolowaną w wielu krajach, w tym w Polsce, co oznacza, że jej stosowanie może być nielegalne. **Podsumowanie**: Chociaż mikrodozowanie psylocybiny ma potencjalne zastosowanie terapeutyczne i może wspomagać leczenie różnych schorzeń neurologicznych, na ten moment nie ma wystarczających badań potwierdzających jej skuteczność w leczeniu neuropatii. Osoby rozważające mikrodozowanie powinny skonsultować się z lekarzem oraz zapoznać się z prawnymi aspektami stosowania psylocybiny w swoim kraju. #borelioza #boreliozaprzewlekła #neuroborelioza #neuropatia #neuropathy #neuropathyrelief #drętwienierąk #drętwienie #nieczujenog #chorobaprzewlekla

Mornings majorly suck when you have POTS.  For as long as I can remember, my heart had pounded ridiculously hard & quick in the mornings as well as a range of other symptoms & throughout the day. I was told told for years that its my anxiety… until this year.. when I received a diagnosis of Postural Tachycardia Syndrome.  Simply standing up can be a challenge for affected people as their body is unable to adjust to gravity. PoTS is due to an abnormal response by the autonomic (automatic) nervous system and is characterised by orthostatic intolerance (the development of symptoms when upright that are mostly relieved by lying down). Symptoms include palpitations, lightheadedness, fatigue, sweating, nausea, fainting and headaches, and are associated with a persistent increase in heart rate from the lying to upright position. Having the Visible band & app personally, really helps me regulate what I am doing. I was hoping that being in a wheelchair would help calm it… it hasn’t 😂😂 #pots #potssyndrome #potsawareness #chronicillness #chronicpain #chronicillnesswarrior #heds #wheelchairlife #wheelchairuser #wheelchairusersoftiktok #disabledtiktok #nervedamage #muscledamage #disabled #disability #neuropathy #posturalorthostatictachycardiasyndrome

LONG TERM SIDE EFFECTS OF PREGABALIN FOR NERVE PAIN **Pregabalin: Important Information and Uses** **Warnings:** 1. **Hypersensitivity (Allergic) Reaction**:  This drug can lead to severe allergic reactions, such as breathing difficulties, rashes, and hives. If you experience any of these symptoms, stop taking it and seek immediate medical help. 2. **Suicidal Thoughts and Behavior**:  Pregabalin may increase the risk of suicidal thoughts and actions. Contact your doctor if you notice unusual mood changes, worsening depression, or thoughts of self-harm. 3. **Dizziness and Drowsiness**:  Pregabalin can cause dizziness, drowsiness, and blurred vision, impairing your ability to think and move. Avoid driving or operating machinery until you know how it affects you. 4. **Misuse**:  Be cautious of misuse, especially if you have a history of drug misuse. Only take pregabalin as prescribed by your doctor. 5. **Respiratory Depression**:  If you use pregabalin along with central nervous system depressants like opioids, it can lead to severe breathing problems. Seek immediate medical help if you experience increased sleepiness or breathing difficulties. **What is Pregabalin?** - Pregabalin is a prescription drug available in capsule, solution, and extended-release tablet forms. This discussion focuses on the capsule form. - It is available as a generic drug and under the brand name Lyrica. - Pregabalin may be used alongside other medications, and its use is closely monitored due to its controlled substance status. **Why it's Used:** - Approved to treat neuropathic pain caused by damaged nerves (from diabetes, shingles, or spinal cord injury) in adults. - Effective for fibromyalgia (widespread body pain) in adults. - Used in combination with other seizure medications to manage partial onset seizures in individuals aged 17 and older. - In certain cases, doctors may prescribe it off-label for children under 17, which means for a purpose not officially approved. **How it Works:** - Pregabalin belongs to a class of drugs called anticonvulsants. - Its precise mechanism of action is unclear but is thought to involve calming damaged or overactive nerves that trigger pain or seizures. In summary, pregabalin is a prescription medication used to manage various conditions, but it carries important warnings regarding allergic reactions, potential for suicidal thoughts, dizziness, misuse, and respiratory issues when combined with certain medications.
